disclaimer: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Synthetic stewardship logic for a prototype; not clinical guidance.

carbapenem_resistant.description: Any isolate in the 14 days up to requested_at tests R to meropenem, ertapenem or imipenem.

esbl_isolated.description: ESBL-producing organism isolated from any specimen in the 14 days up to requested_at.

pcn_allergy_severity.description: Highest severity of penicillin-class allergy. Structured from allergies table if a penicillin-class row exists; otherwise from notes (e.g. 'NKDA', 'no PCN allergy', 'PCN -> anaphylaxis').

septic_shock.description: Current episode: sepsis with vasopressor requirement to maintain MAP >= 65 despite fluid resuscitation.

failed_first_line_therapy.description: Current episode: >= 48h of a first-line agent (e.g. piperacillin-tazobactam, cefepime, ceftriaxone) with clinical worsening or no improvement.

source_control_achieved.description: Current episode: the infection source has been controlled (abscess drained, infected catheter removed, obstruction relieved). False if a source needing control is pending/declined.

outcomes.APPROVE_ELIGIBLE: Criteria for restricted meropenem met (ESBL with shock or uncontrolled source; failed first-line therapy with shock).
outcomes.DENY_ELIGIBLE: Criteria not met: ESBL with controlled source and stable (consider ertapenem step-down) or no ESBL/failure/allergy/shock (first-line agent preferred). Routes to pharmacist, never auto-denied.
outcomes.PHARMACIST_REVIEW: Carbapenem resistance (ID consult), failed first-line without shock, severe penicillin allergy (cross-reactivity/aztreonam decision), or empiric shock without failure.
outcomes.NEED_INFO: A variable needed on the decision path could not be determined from the record.
